items.title: Pseudorandom generators for formulas of low-communication gates via polynomial fooling and NIH recycling
items.author: Valentine Kabanets; Sajin Koroth; Zhenjian Lu; Dimitrios Myrisiotis; Igor C. Oliveira
items.source_version: CCC2020 official complete41-page five-author CC BY3.0 Unported publication; mainTheorem2 wholePRG theme, Sections4.1–4.4 andAppendixA.2 complete proofs, necessarySection3/A.1 shared uncounted context.
items.difficulty_reason: The construction turns low-degree approximation into a quantitative fooling reduction, controls coefficient mass across Boolean bases, combines low-communication leaves with a recursively recycled NIH extractor generator, and proves a separate NOF hybrid within the same complete PRG theorem.
